old_finite_persistence_proof: At an old finite vertex v, expand a new wall in its20 spherical simple normals plus v. The spherical inverse is entrywise nonnegative and all root products nonpositive. A nonpositive v coefficient would pair nonnegatively with the common strict center, impossible. Hence every new wall pairs strictly negatively with every old finite vertex.
